item.description: ### Added - **A Claude background session that is blocked and no longer running shows up in Perch.** A background session can ask for something and then have its process exit, for example after a restart of the Mac. It stays "blocked" in Claude until someone opens it, but it has no process and sends no events, so Perch never showed it. Perch now asks Claude for its own list of sessions, about once a minute, and shows each such session as needing you, with the command that opens it, for example `claude attach 6c4635ce`. There is nothing to reply to or approve from Perch for these; the session has to be opened. A session that was already blocked when Perch started appears quietly. One that becomes blocked while Perch is running sends the usual alert, once. These sessions do not keep the Live Activity card on your phone open. Perch only asks Claude when a background session exists, and it looks for `claude` in `~/.local/bin`, `/opt/homebrew/bin` and `/usr/local/bin`.
